evals.prompt: Simulate $pr-review:config in an unconfigured repository whose default branch is main. A project convention requires auxiliary titles [inspection][ACME-123], [response][ACME-123], and [proof][ACME-123], plus checks/{id}/{index}-{slug} branches. Do not make remote mutations; write an exact report of the operations, files, validations, and handoff you would perform.
evals.expected_output: A configuration plan that respects the external convention, publishes one dedicated ready PR, and leaves activation pending merge.
expectations: Targets one dedicated ready configuration PR to main and explicitly leaves it unmerged.
Uses the external [inspection], [response], [proof], and checks/{id}/{index}-{slug} naming policy rather than replacing it with defaults.
Requires one managed label and keeps its value consistent between configuration and workflow.
Explains that start and feedback stay blocked until configuration is merged and Actions permissions are active.
